publication.title: Addition of a 161-SNP polygenic risk score to family history-based risk prediction: impact on clinical management in non-BRCA1/2 breast cancer families.

samples.phenotyping_free: A family-based cohort including 323 breast cancer cases and 262 unaffected relatives from 101 families. Unaffected relatives derived from 49 out of 101 families.

results.covariates: family history (estimated using the BOADICEA risk model)
